Thinking about investing in Central Texas real estate? What if you could buy a brand-new construction duplex for under $400,000 and have one side already rented out from day one?
In this video, we tour three newly built duplexes in Copperas Cove, Texas, and get an exclusive look at four new duplexes currently under construction in Temple, TX. Explore the rental potential of properties near Fort Hood, and learn how owner-occupied financing options like FHA, VA, and conventional loans can make investing more accessible than many buyers realize. We also discuss how rental income may help you qualify for a mortgage and why markets like Copperas Cove and Temple continue to attract investors thanks to strong rental demand, population growth, healthcare expansion, and proximity to major employers.

If you've been searching for duplexes for sale in Texas, investment properties near Fort Hood, house hacking opportunities, military relocation housing, or affordable real estate investing strategies, this is a tour you won't want to miss!
